Wide landscape transparent canvas roughly 2.2:1 aspect, the bag occupies the left half and the card the right third. Tight composition, very little empty margin, bag knot is clipped by the TOP canvas edge; card can be clipped slightly by RIGHT edge. The silhouettes remain clear. Do not include any shopping bag, receipt, calendar or repeat arrows.
